d:
Saudi Arabia's oil economy is coming under increasing attack as Yemen's Houthi rebels escalate their military campaign against the kingdom. On November 8, the Houthis claimed four military operations targeting King Khalid International Airport, the financial district in Riyadh, Saudi Aramco oil storage facilities and the major oil processing hub of Abqaiq.
An Aramco administrative building in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District sustained damage after an attempted attack. Saudi authorities reported minor damage caused by falling shrapnel, with no casualties.
